description: This file defines the LDAPUser class in the OrangeHRM project, representing an LDAP directory user with various associated attributes, validation, and utility methods.

classes.name: LDAPUser
classes.description: Represents a user fetched from LDAP, encapsulating user attributes and validation logic.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user, validates max length.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username, validating its length against min and max constraints.

methods.name: getUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the LDAP user, if set.

methods.name: setUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID, with length validation and warnings.

methods.name: isUserEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user account is enabled.

methods.name: setUserEnabled
methods.description: Set the enabled state of the user account.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name, validating maximum length.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the middle name, validating maximum length.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name, validating maximum length.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID, validating maximum length.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email address.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email, validating format and length.

methods.name: setUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Associates LDAP user with lookup settings.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Associates the LDAP entry with this user.

methods.name: getEmployeeSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts search filter parameters based on LDAP entry and user settings.

methods.name: getLogInfo
methods.description: Provides log information about the LDAP entry.
